title: Conan lockfile pins a package reference without a recipe revision
description: conan.lock declares a locked reference that omits the recipe revision. Without the revision Conan can resolve a different recipe for the same version, so the lockfile does not freeze the build.
remediation: Re-lock so every reference carries its recipe revision.
limitation: It matches a locked reference that omits the recipe revision in the parsed conan.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
